# HexPiece 3.8.7

The first Mace: the Iron Mace, from your First_mace.blend. **Not tested in game yet:** the build and all test suites pass; every new
mace animation passed the body check (no arm through the body, nothing through the head, never into the floor, every half tick)
and was rendered.

## The Iron Mace (category: Mace)
"Mace Category (Right handed, rests on the back like Yoru, the pull out is slow, when idle the player rests it on it's right shoulder,
has range, hits ragdoll but are slow when cocking them, fast on the swing)."
- **Your model**, whole: the blued black iron club with its six rows of spikes and the ring at the pommel (lightened for phones),
  2.5 blocks long. In the HexPiece Katanas tab after Yoru, with its own icon.
- **Worn on the back like Yoru** and drawn whenever you fight; **pulled off the back slowly** (Yoru's own slow draw) and put back
  the same way.
- **Idle: rested on your right shoulder**, its weight felt: the shoulder sinking under it as you breathe, now and then heaved up
  and let settle again. Walking, it stays on the shoulder.
- **Swings:** its own versions of 14 of the 16 cuts, heavier (the body lower and driven further into each blow), the mace **cocked
  back slowly and swung through fast**, accelerating right up to the hit (the reverse side cut and the plunge stay the katana's for
  now: the mace's thick head brushed the head in them). Between blows it is slower than a blade: each next blow waits
  a moment longer while it is cocked back again.
- **Range:** 2.5 blocks of iron, more reach than a katana.
- **Hits ragdoll:** whatever a mace blow lands on is thrown harder and knocked down, ragdolled, for a moment.
- Black iron already: Armament Haki does not blacken it (its lightning runs round it, as with Yoru).
